3. What PELAV provides

PELAV is an informational fishing-companion app for the South African coast. It provides a personal catch and fishing-session log, a map of fishing spots, weather, sea, tide and moon/solunar information, species information and recommendations, best-fishing-window suggestions and a PELAV Readiness Score. This version of the App has no Premium tier (section 10). Section 7 explains important limits on all of this information.

4. Your catch and session records

You own the catch and session records you enter ("Catch Data"). PELAV stores them, linked to your account, to show you your history and, where available, the conditions recorded when a session started. Database rules allow only your account to read or change your records through the App. PELAV has no public feed or public profile, and does not make your Catch Data public.

A fishing session does not track your location while it is open. If about 12 hours pass we may ask whether you are still fishing; if about 72 hours pass without you returning, the session is marked abandoned. An abandoned session is not treated as a no-catch result.

5. Your responsibilities

You agree to give accurate information, to use PELAV only lawfully and for your own personal purposes, and to comply with all fishing laws and regulations that apply to you (section 8).

6. Location, maps and third-party data

With your permission, PELAV uses your device's location to show nearby fishing spots and to fetch weather, sea and tide information for your area. You can refuse or withdraw location permission at any time in your device settings; some features will then be limited. The Privacy Policy explains exactly where your location is sent.

The fishing-spot markers are a curated directory maintained by PELAV; they are not based on your location history and are not a statement that a spot is safe, open, legal or suitable. Map tiles and weather, sea and tide data come from third parties (section 14) and may be inaccurate, out of date or unavailable.

7. Weather, tide, readiness and recommendation information

Read this before you fish. PELAV's weather, sea, swell, wind, tide, moon/solunar, forecast, species-recommendation, best-fishing-window, Readiness Score and map information is for general planning only. It comes from third-party providers and automated calculations and can be wrong, late, incomplete or unavailable.

This information is not a guarantee of your safety or anyone else's, of marine or navigation safety, of the accuracy of any weather, tide, swell or wind value, of fishing success or fish being present, or of the suitability of any location. It is not emergency information. Tide predictions must not be used for navigation or any purpose where people, property or the environment could be harmed.

The Readiness Score, outlook, best-fishing windows and species recommendations are automated, general guidance based on a limited set of environmental factors. They are not a safety assessment and do not replace your own judgement.

You alone decide whether and where it is safe to fish. Before you go, check official sources such as the South African Weather Service, the National Sea Rescue Institute, your local harbour authority or lifeguards. PELAV does not replace official warnings, marine-safety information, emergency services or local authorities, and must not be relied on in an emergency.

8. Fishing licences, regulations and species information

You are responsible for holding any licence or permit the law requires and for complying with all regulations, including bag and size limits, closed seasons, protected species and marine protected areas.

PELAV's species information, including any closed-season or protected-species information and the App's choice not to recommend a species during a closed season, is general information that may be incomplete or out of date. It is not legal advice and does not tell you what is lawful. Always check the current official regulations.

9. Digital Fishing Licence Vault

The Digital Fishing Licence Vault is not available in this version of the App. You cannot add, replace, view or delete a licence document in the App.

If you stored a licence document with an earlier version of the App, it stays in the App's private storage on that device, kept separately for each PELAV account signed in on that device. PELAV does not upload it or have access to it, and it is not included in Android backups or device transfers. You can remove it from the device by deleting your PELAV account in the App (section 16), by clearing the App's data in your device settings, or uninstalling the App. Clearing the App's data or uninstalling the App also removes the other information the App keeps on that device (see the Privacy Policy). If you lose or reset your device, the copy is lost.

PELAV does not issue, verify, renew, authenticate or replace any licence; your original licence and the licensing authority's requirements still apply.

10. Free access

This version of the App is free. It has no Premium tier and no Premium-only features: every feature it offers, including Solunar Activity and best-fishing-window suggestions, is available to every account. It does not sell subscriptions or offer free trials, and there is no purchase or restore-purchase option in it. The Length-to-Weight calculator is not available in this version of the App.

If we introduce paid features in a later version, we will first publish updated Terms and ask you to accept them, and we will show the price, billing period and how to cancel before you are asked to pay.
